title: Pöschl Tabak drives global travel retail expansion with Pueblo ...
content: # Pöschl Tabak drives global travel retail expansion with Pueblo tobacco products. In 2023 alone, the company unveiled 20 duty-free stores focusing on fine cut additive-free tobacco products from its Pueblo brand. “As a medium-sized company among the big players, it is important to always have the right instincts for market niches and thereby impress with a proven tradition with products of excellent quality,” noted the 121-year-old tobacco house. It is a leading producer of snuff and a group-independent manufacturer of tobacco products such as fine-cut, cigarettes and pipe tobacco – focusing on quality and further internationalisation. In travel retail Pöschl Tabak is pushing Pueblo: “We aim to improve the global development of our most famous fine-cut product Pueblo. “Pueblo is, in simple words, a story of success, being one of the fastest-growing fine-cut products in the world as well as Europe’s (and global) market leader in the segment ‘fine cut without additives’.
